messages:
Aisha Khan: Drafting a short customer-facing RCA + mitigation note for the onboarding wave affected by yesterday's ingest timeout. I want to send targeted to high-touch customers first; will broadcast to others after. Draft in 20m for review.

Marcos Rivera: Please include a one-line apology at the top and clarify "impacted" vs "degraded" for SLA language. Also include how credits will be calculated (overage fees during outage window).

Lena Chen: SRE summary: a malformed protobuf bypassed our upstream checks, triggering retry loops in ingest workers and backing up onboarding queues. Remediation: we deployed a schema-validation gate and rate-limited replays to restore throughput.

Aisha Khan: Can you paste the SRE sentence and confirm the UTC window?

Lena Chen: SRE line: "Root cause: a malformed protobuf message bypassed validation and caused excessive retries in our ingest workers, which led to queue backlog." Window: 2026-03-22 03:10:12Z 3:48:09Z.

Jae Park: For any customers with >$5k ARR in onboarding, recommend 1:1 outreach and offer a complimentary enablement session + 1 month waived ingestion overage. I'll upload the targeted list shortly.

Aisha Khan: Adding that language: "If you were onboarding and experienced disruption, we'll schedule a dedicated enablement session and apply a credit for ingestion overages during the outage window."

Support Bot: IncidentBot: Incident #2026-INGEST-874 detected 2026-03-22T03:10:12Z, resolved 2026-03-22T03:48:09Z. Postmortem draft: https://redwood-internal/pg/INGEST-874/postmortem

Marcos Rivera: Customer opener suggestion: "We're sorry 3 March 22 between 03:10 and 03:48 UTC, some onboarding ingestion jobs were delayed. We've fixed the root cause and completed replays; here's what we did and how we'll help." Keep bullets concise: impact, actions, next steps, credits, contact.

Aisha Khan: Draft email: "Hi {{first_name}},
We're sorry 3 March 22 between 03:10 and 03:48 UTC some onboarding ingestion jobs for a subset of customers were delayed due to a malformed message in our pipeline. We've fixed the issue, completed backfills for primary onboarding flows, and added safeguards to prevent recurrence.
What we did:
 Deployed a schema validation gate to block malformed protobufs.
 Rate-limited replays to avoid downstream spikes.
 Completed backfill of primary onboarding queues; if you still see missing records, open a ticket and we'll prioritize.
What to expect:
 A dedicated enablement office hour for affected onboarding customers (links below).
 Ingestion overage fees during the outage window will be credited. High-touch customers will receive an additional one-month platform credit.
 Attached: brief RCA and FAQ.
Reply to this email to request a 1:1 walkthrough.
Sincerely,
Aisha Khan, Customer Success"

Lena Chen: LGTM. Add: "We've added upstream schema checks to reject malformed messages earlier in the pipeline."

Jae Park: Uploaded high-touch list: https://redwood-internal/drive/high-touch-onboard-3-22.csv. Sales: please follow up on flagged renewal-risk accounts for personalized outreach.

Marcos Rivera: Approve credit wording: "We will apply a credit equivalent to ingestion overage charges incurred during the outage window. For high-touch customers, we will also provide an additional one-month credit for platform usage."

Aisha Khan: Final plan: send targeted emails in 30m, host two office hours (APAC and EMEA/AMER), attach brief RCA, file customer copies on incident page, and loop Sales for renewal outreach. Thanks team :heart:

Support Bot: DeployBot: Schema-validation gate enabled at 2026-03-22T04:05:22Z.
